BWA.note: Only BoFiNet, a state-owned wholesale operator, uses AI (fault-call assistant, network tools); not a public administration body.
Says only that a ministry team is looking at AI policy; no strategy drafting stated.
BoFiNet's Digital Delta data centre is described as being built and awaiting Tier III certification; not stated in service for hire.

facts.fact: BoFiNet's Acting CEO says the state-funded operator has connected 223 of 503 gazetted villages with fibre, relying on government capital funding for rural connectivity.

BWA.note: No budget amount, year or law stated; mentions of government capital funding and BOCRA's 1% levy payment from BoFiNet are too general to place.
An exchange point is only planned inside a data centre under construction; none in service.

facts.fact: BoFiNet's Acting CEO says it has laid about 12,400 km of fibre covering over 80% of the population, with about 2,000 km more needed to reach the remaining villages.
BoFiNet's Acting CEO says it holds a wholesale-only licence and sells capacity to ISPs and mobile operators.

BWA.note: Describes a state company's network and AI tools, not government systems run by government staff.
Digital Delta is stated as being built and awaiting certification; not in service.

facts.fact: BoFiNet's Acting CEO says it has fibre connections to all of Botswana's neighbouring countries, including a major route through South Africa.
BoFiNet's Acting CEO says Starlink is sold to customers in Botswana, with saturation in Gaborone and a pause in selling terminals when it reached capacity.
